description: The Earth Rooster in Chinese astrology: personality, Earth element traits, 1969 and 2029 dates and compatibility.
answer: In Chinese astrology, the Earth Rooster is the Rooster born in a Earth year, one of five versions of the tenth animal. It combines the Rooster's precision with Earth's qualities. Earth Rooster years between 1924 and 2044 are 1969 and 2029. The Rooster's fixed element is Metal.

sections.heading: The Earth Rooster personality
paragraphs: Earth generates Metal, and the Rooster's fixed element is Metal, so an Earth year is said to nourish this precise animal, adding stability and depth to its natural diligence. Earth Roosters are commonly described as methodical, responsible and deeply reliable, with a gift for organisation and long-term planning. They often care a great deal about doing things properly and make trustworthy managers, administrators and craftspeople. Supported rather than challenged by their year element, they usually feel secure in their competence. That security can become inflexibility, however, and readings suggest Earth Roosters may resist new methods, cling to their way of doing things and become quietly critical of anyone who works differently.

In classical thought, Earth belongs to the centre and to the late-summer pause between seasons, the point where things ripen and settle. As a year stem, it tends to slow an animal down in a useful way, adding prudence, loyalty and a strong sense of responsibility. People born under an Earth stem are often described as dependable, sensible and protective of the people they love. They value security and tend to build carefully. The caution traditionally attached to Earth is caution itself: overthinking, clinging to the familiar and carrying other people's problems as though they were their own.

sections.heading: Earth Rooster at work and in love
paragraphs: At work, Earth is usually associated with management, organisation and long-term stewardship. Earth-year people are often described as the steady hands who keep systems running, look after budgets and notice when colleagues are struggling, which suits administration, property, finance, agriculture, healthcare and operations. They tend to earn trust slowly and keep it. The traditional caution is resistance to change: an Earth stem may hold on to a process after it has stopped working, so regular reviews and a willingness to experiment help.

Meticulous and reliable, the Earth Rooster brings superb organisation to any workplace. Accountancy, audit, administration, logistics and quality assurance are typical matches, since rigour and consistency matter most there. It thrives with clear procedures, an orderly desk and rewards for accuracy, and it tends to be the person who catches the error everyone else missed. In love, the Earth Rooster is steady, responsible and practical, keeping the household's paperwork in immaculate order. It needs order and fairness. Perfectionism is the pressure point: it may expect a partner to meet the same exacting standards about tidiness, budgets or schedules, and voice disappointment when they do not.

sections.heading: Earth Rooster years and dates
paragraphs: The table from 1924 to 2044 holds 2 Earth Rooster years: 1969, starting Feb 17 and 2029, starting Feb 13. Because the year begins at Lunar New Year, a birthday in January or early February needs checking: in 1969 anyone born before Feb 17 is a Earth Monkey, not a Earth Rooster. It takes sixty years for the Earth stem and the Rooster branch to coincide again, which is why the same pairing marks grandparents and grandchildren rather than siblings. Every Earth Rooster year is Yin, matching the Rooster's own polarity.

In the sexagenary calendar this is the Ji-You year, the Earth stem Ji with the Rooster's branch You. Births just before each new year fall in the Earth Monkey year (before February 17, 1969) and the Earth Monkey year (before February 13, 2029), and births in the weeks after each Earth Rooster year ends belong to the Metal Dog. The new year itself fell on a Monday in 1969 and Tuesday in 2029.

sections.heading: Growth edges and compatibility for the Earth Rooster
paragraphs: Earth Roosters gain most by practising openness to methods other than their own. Asking 'what would happen if we tried it your way?' once in a while can produce surprising improvements and warmer working relationships. Because they shoulder responsibility so readily, scheduling genuine leisure prevents dutifulness from crowding out joy. Earth Roosters often benefit from hobbies that reward patience with beauty, such as woodwork, baking or restoration. Saying appreciation aloud matters too, since they may assume their care is obvious. With flexibility added to diligence, Earth Roosters become the trusted backbone of any team or family.

For relationships, the classical structures belong to the animal rather than the element, so the Earth Rooster shares the Rooster's San He trine with the Ox and Snake (the Metal trine), its Liu He bond with the Dragon, and its Liu Chong clash with the Rabbit. The element adds a second layer: another Earth sign shares this year element, while partners whose year element feeds Earth in the generating cycle are often described as supportive.

faq.question: What years are Earth Rooster years?
faq.answer: Between 1924 and 2044: 1969 (from February 17, 1969) and 2029 (from February 13, 2029). Each lasts until the day before the next Lunar New Year.

faq.question: What is the Earth Rooster's element relationship?
faq.answer: The year element is Earth and the Rooster's fixed element is Metal; in the five-element cycles earth generates Metal. Readings use that relationship to describe how easily the two sides of the sign sit together.

faq.question: Which animals are most compatible with the Earth Rooster?
faq.answer: Traditionally the Ox and Snake (San He) and the Dragon (Liu He). The Rabbit is the Liu Chong clash. These pairings depend on the animal, whatever the element.

faq.question: What is the Earth Rooster called in the Chinese calendar?
faq.answer: Ji-You. In almanacs and Four Pillars charts each year is named by its heavenly stem, here the Earth stem Ji, followed by its earthly branch, here You for the Rooster, so the name pins down both halves of the combination at once.

faq.question: How is the Earth Rooster different from other Roosters?
faq.answer: All Roosters share precision, candour and diligence. The Earth year element changes the tone: earth sits at the centre of the five-element wheel, and an Earth year is traditionally said to give any animal steadiness, patience and a practical turn of mind.
